network_state: Three regional contract areas and the Opava town network

Opavsko (licences 902xxx) and Vítkovsko (903xxx) of Z-Group bus, Hlučínsko (904xxx) of Transdev Slezsko, and the town lines of Opava (905xxx) of Městský dopravní podnik Opava. Each has its own section below; the trolleybuses are a section of their own.
Their timetables are in CIS JŘ's city-transport JDF (traction T), not in the bus export; they are read the same way and modelled as trolleybus lines (the owner asked for them).

Each trolleybus route (OpenStreetMap route relations) was checked against the wire mapped in OpenStreetMap, every 10 m, 25 m tolerance. 201, 202 and 203 are under the wire all the way. 204 has two unwired stretches: Ratibořská – Vrchní – U Cukrovaru – Pekařská – Divadlo (about 2.0 km without wire) and Kylešovice, Bílovecká – Hlavní – škola (0.6 km in a straight line between the stops, about 1 km by the timetable; the OSM relation stops at Bílovecká, so this end was added from the timetable's stops, which have no wire within 100 m). Wikipedia marks the same stops as partial-trolleybus stops. 202's single daily trip to Malé Hoštice also leaves the wire; it is not modelled.

Road repairs on Vrchní street in Kateřinky: one-way 12–20 Oct, full closure 21–23 Oct. On the vehicle day 204 ran with replacement buses via Partyzánská (trips 40xx on the live map, MDPO Citelis 150–157). The closure ends this week, so 204 is modelled as the regular trolleybus line with designed trolleybuses (owner check).
Short diversions: the regular routes are modelled

241 and 243 (Opava, Psychiatrická léčebna not served, 28 Sep – 23 Nov), 262 (the same stop, 5 Oct – 23 Nov), 253 (Služovice, obecní úřad, 7 Sep – 31 Oct) and 284 (Dolní Benešov, Zábřeh, Mexiko, 16–21 Oct; also 256 and 275, which are listed). Short works are modelled as the regular state.
Diversions to the end of the timetable year
234, 242 and 261 skip Březová, střed until 11 Dec; 263 and 264 run diversion versions with the same stops until 12 Dec. They are modelled as they run.

615, 620, 691, 692 and 693 (minor Vítkovsko/Opavsko licences) are on the Novojičínsko/Bílovecko sheet. This sheet models 260 and 920 (also Bruntálsko/Rýmařovsko licences), 261, 263, 270, 285 and 678 (also Novojičínsko/Bílovecko licences) and 555 (the Havířovsko/Karvinsko/Orlovsko sheet lists it as Hlučínsko's).

texts.eyebrow: ODIS regional buses and Opava town buses and trolleybuses · Opavsko · Vítkovsko · Hlučínsko · MHD Opava · vypravenost
texts.lede_who: The ODIS bus lines of three regional contract areas (Opavsko and Vítkovsko of Z-Group bus, Hlučínsko of Transdev Slezsko) and the Opava town network of Městský dopravní podnik Opava, buses and trolleybuses
texts.scope: Licences with the area prefixes 902 (Opavsko) and 903 (Vítkovsko) of Z-Group bus, 904 (Hlučínsko) of Transdev Slezsko and 905 (MHD Opava) of Městský dopravní podnik Opava; the trolleybus lines 201–204 (905201–905204) from CIS JŘ's city-transport JDF (draha/mestske, downloaded 21 Oct 2026), the rest
texts.scope_check: The prefixes match the live map (Z-Group, pr. Opava; Transdev Slezsko pr. Ostrava; MDPO) and the fleet numbers (22-, 23-, 24-). A line holding a second licence on the Bruntálsko or Novojičínsko sheet is modelled on the sheet with most of its trips.
texts.buses_extra: MDPO's vehicles appear on the live map as MDPO<fleet number> and are joined to the MDPO register by number. Trolleybus 204 ran with replacement buses on the day (Vrchní street closure, 12–23 Oct); it is modelled as the regular trolleybus line, and its trolleybuses are designed: MDPO trolleybuses not in service that afternoon, with an auxiliary drive for its unwired sections. A trolleybus with an auxiliary drive shows it after its type (+ battery, + diesel generator), from its register page.
texts.depots: Z-Group bus's Opava branch (22- Opavsko, 23- Vítkov), Transdev Slezsko pr. Ostrava (Hlučínsko's 24- buses) and MDPO's Opava depot (buses and trolleybuses). A seen bus counts at the branch the live map reports for it; a designed one at its home branch.
texts.sources_extra: , CIS JŘ city-transport JDF (Opava trolleybuses), Z-Group bus, MDPO and Transdev Morava registers, MDPO notice on the Vrchní closure, overhead wire and trolleybus routes from OpenStreetMap (Overpass, 22 Oct 2026), checked against Wikipedia’s partial-trolleybus stops; battery and diesel-generator trolleybuses from their register pages (“alternativní pohon”)

pak.why: Fleet desk (pak session simutrans-custom-czech-pak128-35), 21 Oct 2026: regional buses take VZ-ODIS-bus; Z-Group's white with the kraj logo is bila, Transdev Slezsko's Hlučínsko scheme is the red ring (bilacervenykruh) or the red Transdev logo (transdev); MDPO's buses take VZ-DPOpava-bus and its trolleybuses VZ-DPOpava-trolleybus (advertising wraps run in the plain livery, final). 22 Oct: the battery 32 Tr (314–323) take 32Tr_battery and the diesel-generator 26 Tr (305–306) 26TrDG, which can leave the wire (204's Vrchní street and Kylešovice škola).
